Definition: from G2596 intensive and G1212; manifest:--far more evident.
BiblicalUsage: It is far more evident that another priest arises after the likeness of Melchisedec, not after Aaron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the new priesthood is not a small repair but a far clearer proof that Christ is the priest we need.
